# Final Finish Epoxy Coatings

Final Finish Epoxy Coatings is an Edmonton flooring contractor founded by Denis. It installs Torginol polymer flake floors (any Torginol colour, plus custom blends) and does the concrete work underneath them. Six services: Residential and Commercial Floors; Surface Preparation; Concrete Repair, Levelling and Diamond Grinding; Crack Filling; Decorative Epoxy; Anti-Slip Coating. The service area is Edmonton and Central Alberta, up to about 145 km out, including St. Albert and Athabasca. Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Google Business Profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=7470239776211762202

## Contact

- Phone: (780) 991-1651
- Email: finalfinishepoxy@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.finalfinishepoxy.ca/
